protocol_type: Time-triggered TDMA + FTDMA frame protocol. The host hands frame data to the Communication Controller over the CHI; the CC schedules the frame into its assigned static slot (TDMA) or its priority minislot (FTDMA dynamic), builds the frame (5-byte header + payload + 24-bit Frame CRC), and the Bus Driver serializes it as differential NRZ on BP/BM at up to 10 Mbit/s. The receiver oversamples 8x, majority-votes, re-strobes per Byte Start Sequence, and checks the Header and Frame CRCs.

channels.name: Channel A (BP/BM)
channels.description: Differential NRZ automotive bus at up to 10 Mbit/s; shared TDMA/FTDMA media access; one slot owner drives at a time.

channels.name: Channel B (BP/BM)
channels.description: Independent second channel; redundancy or doubled bandwidth. A node may use one or both channels.

channels.name: TxD / TxEN / RxD (CC <-> Bus Driver)
channels.description: TxD = transmit data, TxEN = transmit enable (gates the bus driver to the node's own slots), RxD = received data.

communication_cycle.note: All segment boundaries are defined in macroticks and are statically configured identically across the cluster.

media_access.static_segment: TDMA — each static slot owned by one configured node per channel; Frame ID = slot number; collision-free, deterministic; the slot counter advances every static slot.
media_access.dynamic_segment: FTDMA / minislotting — minislots traversed in Frame-ID priority order (lower ID = higher priority); a transmitting node holds the minislot counter for its frame, otherwise the minislot elapses.

frame_format.frame_id_range: 1..2047 (0 reserved); in static segment Frame ID = slot number
frame_format.framing: TSS (Transmission Start Sequence) + FSS (Frame Start Sequence) + per-byte BSS (Byte Start Sequence) + FES (Frame End Sequence); no bit stuffing.

frame_indicator_bits: Payload Preamble Indicator (Network Management Vector in static / Message ID in dynamic)
Null Frame Indicator (slot transmitted but no valid application data)
Sync Frame Indicator (frame used by clock synchronization; static segment only)
Startup Frame Indicator (frame used during coldstart; always also a sync frame)

crc.header_crc_coverage: sync indicator, startup indicator, Frame ID, Payload Length

symbols.name: CAS
symbols.use: Sent by the leading coldstart node before startup frames to claim an idle channel.

symbols.name: MTS
symbols.use: Network-management test symbol in the symbol window.

symbols.name: WUS / WUP
symbols.use: WUP = repeated WUS; wakes a channel before communication.

addressing.note: FlexRay is slot/Frame-ID addressed, not node-address addressed: a frame is identified by its Frame ID (11-bit) and the slot/cycle in which it appears, not by a destination address. In the static segment Frame ID = slot number.
